§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 travel vocabulary to advanced C1 itinerary strategy and analytics discourse, every module is anchored in real-world travel scenarios — from client consultations to digital booking platforms, from business travel management to luxury travel design. Built for use inside travel agencies, tour operators, corporate travel departments, and online travel platforms.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from booking platforms, itinerary design, and travel agency operations in 2026.

02

AI & automation

AI-powered trip planning, smart itinerary tools, and predictive booking systems run throughout the program — reflecting today's travel industry.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with executive-level performance feedback and improvement guidance after every exercise.

04

Case-led pedagogy

Mini case studies bring real travel industry dilemmas — booking crises, itinerary disruptions, service recovery — into language learning.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Travel Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international travel professionals. Horizon reflects his vision: language learning as journey capability — a multiplier of careers, itineraries, and influence.

Designed for the travel agents, tour designers, and travel executives shaping global travel — Horizon is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to plan the journey in one of the most personal industries in the world.
